current_evidence: The 'Applying for planning permission' page (last updated 29/01/2025), its 'Planning application forms' child page and the planning section index contain no link to a local validation list, and site-restricted web searches returned no Chesterfield local list document within the call budget.

issues.detail: The 'Validation list URL' is a generic 'Applying for planning permission' web page, not a local validation list. It loads fine (it is not blocked/404/login), but it does not contain or link to any local list or validation checklist; it only says that a validation team checks applications and may make them invalid.
issues.evidence: Page text: 'checks are carried out by our validation team to ensure that all information required...'; no validation list linked. 'Last updated on 29/01/2025.'

issues.detail: The Status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' is inaccurate. The page is publicly readable. The real position is that no published Chesterfield local validation list could be found on the council website. The row should say no local list is published or found, not that the link is blocked.
issues.evidence: WebFetch of the workbook URL succeeded and returned the full page content.

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' field is only the council home page (https://www.chesterfield.gov.uk). A more useful entry is the planning permission and development management section, which links to the BNG, CIL, trees and development, contaminated land and climate change guidance pages that hold topic-specific submission guidance.

summary: Grokbot's link is a generic, readable 'applying for planning permission' page, not a validation list. It is not blocked as the Status claims, and no current Chesterfield local validation list could be found on the council site, so the contents could not be checked.
